hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler vaults. In beforeSwap, it takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, verifies a custom bonding-curve invariant, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — bypassing Uniswap's internal liquidity entirely. Each pool instance is deployed as a delegatecall proxy of this implementation.
